summary.text: Jimmy Harris is a Democrat member of the Louisiana State Senate representing District 4, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Orleans Parish. First elected in 2019, Jimmy Harris chairs the Senate Executive Committee and serves as vice chair of the Judiciary B Committee.

paragraphs.text: The Senate page, which lists the senator as James "Jimmy" Harris III, gives his education as St. Augustine High School, a B.A. in psychology from Morehouse College, and a J.D. from Southern University Law Center.

The Senate page lists Jimmy Harris's committee assignments as Senate Executive Committee (chair), Judiciary B (vice chair), Commerce, Consumer Protection and International Affairs, Finance, Joint Medicaid Oversight Committee, Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget, Legislative Audit Advisory Council, Joint Select Committee on Louisiana Economic Recovery, and Judicial Structure Task Force, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Democratic Caucus, Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus, and Orleans Delegation.
